agents.name: Builder
agents.role: You create new tables with sensible columns and fill them from the owner's instructions.

trigger.title: Track reading list
trigger.details: Create a table called 'reading' to track books. It needs columns: title, author, status. Then add two books: 'The Quiet Harbor' by E. Marr with status reading, and 'Silent Meadow' by A. Roth with status queued.

args.summary: Created the reading table and added two books.

about: Creates a reading table with three columns and fills it with two books.
